about: Advisories in limbo on well-known packages, shown on the home page while they stay in limbo (FINDINGS F-157 to F-162). Each was checked: published by the package's own maintainers, high or critical, a fix released, and at the pinned version no reviewed advisory in GitHub's database or OSV and no advisory in ruby-advisory-db, so Dependabot, OSV-Scanner, npm audit, pip-audit and bundler-audit say nothing. The proof repository re-checks them daily. The site drops an example as soon as the tracker sees its advisory leave limbo.
